item.title: Uncensored models are awesome
item.description:
Has anyone been experimenting with ablated or uncensored variants of open-source models like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen 3.8 27B, or GLM 5.3 flash?

It's so refreshing to have models that just do wh | why kept: qwen, model, qwen
